We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably need to get 1H NMR and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but no argument). The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it likely returns the 1H NMR of the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it. Then interpret peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm, integration of 3H each. The tool returns spectra as string with peaks and integrals? Not sure format. Could also use carbon_nmr_spectra to see number of methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). But easier: get proton NMR.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
